prompt_en: Create a cinematic historical-fashion photograph of a palace court scene in a Joseon-era Korean royal residence. A woman waits for a court audience beneath a covered corridor, standing just beside a closed red lattice door. Use the supplied image as the visual reference for her face and hair: preserve the soft oval facial contour, dark brown eyes, straight dark chin-length bob, and airy separated fringe. Her composed presence and softly alert gaze carry a subtle personal attraction. She wears a deep crimson silk dangui with a clean white collar over a full indigo skirt. Its long rounded front and back panels separate at the side slits; at the near hip, the side opening clearly divides the front panel from the back panel, both hanging independently over the skirt. Short white cuff extensions are attached directly at both sleeve ends, visibly continuing from the crimson sleeves beside her supporting wrists. The rich fabric has weight and quiet surface sheen. She supports a small dark lacquer tray level at her waist, one palm beneath each side, with one neatly folded ivory document lying at its center. Her eyes have turned toward the still-closed doorway while her body remains settled in place, making the short wait feel consequential. Damp courtyard paving beyond the corridor and a narrow strip of clearing morning sky suggest a rain shower has just passed. Dark timber columns, painted eave brackets, and a raised stone threshold establish the palace around her. Frame her from head to below the knees in a three-quarter view, placing her on the left and letting the red door occupy the right half. Keep her face, both supporting hands, tray, folded document, and the door latch legible together. The near side slit, the distinct rounded front and back panels, and both sleeve-to-white-cuff attachments remain clear in this same three-quarter view. Cool reflected daylight from the courtyard grazes the crimson silk and her cheek, while the interior corridor remains softly shaded. Photograph the texture of skin, woven silk, worn timber, and damp stone with believable depth and restrained colors. The waiting figure, carried document, and closed doorway form the entire dramatic relationship.
